verdict: The patch (.msp) cannot be applied because the base product is not installed.
fix: Add a dependency on the base-product deployment type in MECM, or reshape the deployment so the base MSI and the patch ship together via a wrapper script (`install.ps1` that installs the base then the patch). Do not rely on the MECM client to retry the patch; the detection method on the patch will keep returning false until the base is present.
